body.name: All-arm frontier handle
body.construction: \(\mathfrak H_{\mathrm{frontier}}\) applies the finite family in Definition \(\mathrm{def:simultaneous-perturbation-family}\) to seek \(\Delta_{N,K}\) with \(\operatorname{TV}_{\mathrm{mix}}\le1/4\) and nonnegative reduced-cost slack for every rematching column; its alternative branch derives a shared bound for the jointly \(c_K\)-conjugate tuple by common-support interpolation. Either branch is paired with \(\mathsf{CertMOT}_\epsilon\).
